notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: Giannis is probable with right groin tendinitis and played 36 minutes on Wednesday after missing Sunday, so the groin did not limit him. New York is still without OG Anunoby, who is doubtful, and the Knicks no longer have Mitchell Robinson to throw at him.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: Towns is off the injury report after the knee inflammation that cost him a game last week, and he played 33 minutes on Wednesday. Anunoby is doubtful and backup center Andre Drummond is questionable after taking a hit to the head on Wednesday, so the frontcourt minutes run through Towns.
notes.Jalen Brunson: Brunson played 36 minutes on Wednesday and stays the one sure thing in a Knicks lineup with OG Anunoby doubtful and Jordan Clarkson and Miles McBride questionable. Fewer healthy guards behind him means more of the ball handling stays with him.
notes.Josh Hart: Hart is off the injury report even though he said his right shoulder has bothered him for a couple of weeks. He has played 35 or more minutes in each of his last three games with Anunoby out, and Anunoby is doubtful again.
notes.Scottie Barnes: Barnes is the clear lead option again with Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett both out; Leonard has only just started individual on-court work. He played 38 minutes in Toronto's last game.
notes.Allen Graves: Graves has started both games since RJ Barrett went out, playing 33 and 31 minutes. Barrett and Kawhi Leonard are out again, so the starting spot should stay his.
notes.Jayson Tatum: Tatum played 37 minutes on Monday and Boston gets an Atlanta team missing CJ McCollum, Jock Landale, Mouhamed Gueye and Asa Newell. Mitchell Robinson is questionable with an illness, which could put more of the frontcourt load on Neemias Queta.
notes.Neemias Queta: Queta started and played 25 minutes on Monday. Mitchell Robinson, who has not played since November 18, is questionable with an illness, so Queta's role holds if Robinson sits again.
notes.Taylor Hendricks: Hendricks has played 24 to 27 minutes off the bench in the three games without Cameron Boozer, though his production has been thin. Zach Edey is questionable after sitting the second half on Wednesday with ankle soreness, and Memphis started Hendricks the last time Edey missed a game.
notes.Olivier-Maxence Prosper: Prosper has played 19 to 23 minutes off the bench in Memphis's last three games with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out. Both are out again, and Edey and Isaiah Stewart are questionable, so the Memphis frontcourt is thin.
notes.Jaylen Wells: Wells has started every recent game for Memphis and played 27 minutes on Wednesday after a 20-minute night on Monday. Boozer, Grant and Scotty Pippen Jr. are all out again.
notes.Kris Murray: Murray has started the last two games at power forward with Cameron Boozer out and played 32 minutes in each. Boozer is out again, so the job stays his.
notes.Ty Jerome: Jerome has started every game since returning from his hip injury, playing 29 and 25 minutes, and Memphis is still without Scotty Pippen Jr. and Boozer. His minutes have stayed below his early-season level, so the ceiling is there but the playing time is the question.
notes.Corey Kispert: Kispert played 19 minutes off the bench in Atlanta's last game. CJ McCollum is out with a left calf strain, which opens more wing minutes behind the starters.
notes.Luguentz Dort: Dort played 31 minutes off the bench in Atlanta's last game. CJ McCollum, Jock Landale and Mouhamed Gueye are all out, so Atlanta's rotation is short and Dort's minutes should hold.
notes.Kingston Flemings: Flemings is back in Atlanta's starting lineup after returning on November 22, when he played 27 minutes. CJ McCollum is out with a calf strain, which leaves more of the ball handling to him.
notes.Javonte Green: Green played 27 minutes off the bench on Monday with Cade Cunningham and Duncan Robinson out. Cunningham is out again with knee tendinopathy and Robinson with a quad strain, so the wing minutes are still open.
notes.Ron Holland: Holland played 17 minutes on Monday without Cade Cunningham and Duncan Robinson. Both are out again Friday, along with Jalen Duren, so Detroit is short on wings.
notes.Daniss Jenkins: Jenkins has started every recent game and played 35 to 39 minutes in his last four. Cade Cunningham is out again with right knee tendinopathy and his next chance is Sunday, so Jenkins runs the offense again.
notes.Ausar Thompson: With Cade Cunningham out again, Thompson takes on more of the ball handling; he had 7 assists in 31 minutes on Monday without Cunningham. Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson are also still out.
notes.Isaiah Joe: Joe moved into Detroit's starting lineup on Monday with Cunningham and Duncan Robinson out and played 30 minutes. Both are out again Friday.
notes.Anfernee Simons: Jaylen Brown is out after leaving Wednesday's game at halftime with left hamstring tightness, and Simons averaged about 32 minutes in the three earlier games Brown missed. He played only 15 minutes on Wednesday, so the bump depends on Nick Nurse going back to him.
notes.Kentavious Caldwell-Pope: Caldwell-Pope played 28 minutes off the bench on Wednesday when Jaylen Brown left at halftime. Brown is out Friday, which opens a starting wing spot.
notes.Tyrese Maxey: Maxey played 37 minutes on Wednesday, and Jaylen Brown is out Friday with a hamstring issue. Joel Embiid is questionable with an illness after missing two games, so Maxey's usage could climb even higher.
notes.Joel Embiid: Embiid is questionable with an illness after missing Philadelphia's last two games. Friday is the first night of a back-to-back.
notes.LeBron James: LeBron is off the injury report for Friday, the first night of a back-to-back, after playing 35 minutes on Wednesday. With Jaylen Brown out and Embiid questionable, he and Maxey carry the offense.
notes.Pascal Siakam: Siakam is Indiana's lead scorer again with Tyrese Haliburton out. T.J. McConnell, Kelly Oubre Jr. and Larry Nance Jr. are all questionable, which could push even more of the offense to him.
Oubre is questionable with a right hand laceration after playing 28 minutes as a starter on Monday. If he sits, Indiana loses another wing with Haliburton already out.
notes.LaMelo Ball: Ball is questionable with a left ankle sprain, and Chris Finch said it looked bad but he was not sure how severe it is. Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo are still out, so Minnesota is very thin at guard if Ball sits.
notes.Jaden McDaniels: McDaniels has played 34 to 39 minutes in his last five games with Anthony Edwards out, and scored 32 on Wednesday after his career-high 34 on Monday. Edwards is out again and LaMelo Ball is questionable, so the wing load stays with him.
Shannon has come off the bench for 20 to 24 minutes in Minnesota's last two games. LaMelo Ball is questionable with an ankle sprain, and if Ball sits Shannon is a candidate to move into the starting lineup.
notes.Ayo Dosunmu: Dosunmu has started and played 30 and 35 minutes in Minnesota's last two games with Anthony Edwards out. LaMelo Ball is questionable, and if Ball sits Dosunmu takes over more of the ball handling.
Brown has started Brooklyn's last two games, though he played only 23 minutes on Wednesday. Nolan Traore is out again with a hamstring strain, and Brooklyn has been careful with Brown's workload, with a back-to-back on Saturday.
notes.Day'Ron Sharpe: Sharpe played 31 minutes on Wednesday, his most in recent games. Moritz Wagner is out with knee soreness, so Sharpe should get the bulk of the backup center minutes again.
notes.Victor Wembanyama: Wembanyama played 35 minutes on Wednesday after sitting Monday with back tightness, and he is off Friday's injury report. De'Aaron Fox and Dylan Harper are questionable, which decides how much of the offense lands on him.
notes.Stephon Castle: Castle has run the Spurs offense for 34 to 37 minutes in each of the last two games with Fox and Dylan Harper out. Both are questionable Friday, so his role shrinks if they return.
notes.Jalen Green: Green's minutes jumped to 37 and 35 in Phoenix's last two games after he played about 21 a night earlier in November, a sign Phoenix has gone back to its regular starters.
notes.Damian Lillard: Lillard played 34 minutes on Wednesday and Portland is without Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe. Golden State is missing Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porzingis, which takes most of the bite out of its defense.
notes.Jusuf Nurkic: Nurkic is questionable with a foot injury and would be making his season debut. Jaxson Hayes is also questionable, so Utah's center minutes are unsettled against Denver.
notes.Zach Edey: Edey is questionable after sitting the second half on Wednesday with left ankle soreness. His minutes were already limited to about 20 to 23 a night, so even if he plays the workload is small.
